role_raw: Mach-Zehnder Interferometer (2x2) with integrated TiN heaters
query: mzi_2x2 mzi mach_zehnder 2x2 interferometer C-band operation. Use 500 nm-wide waveguides throughout the MZI. Include integrated TiN heaters (one per arm or as required by design) with heater length = 10 µm. Provide two optical input ports and two optical output ports per MZI (2x2). Two cascaded TiN-heated MZIs for C-band Photonic circuit comprising two Mach-Zehnder interferometers connected in series (cascaded). Each MZI includes integrated TiN heaters for thermo-optic phase tuning in C-band. Waveguides are 500 nm wide; each heater is 10 µm long. Each MZI is a 2x2 device (two inputs, two outputs). Two-stage cascaded 2x2 MZI network with thermo-optic tunability via integrated TiN heaters for C-band operation.
